checks.description: Real junction order and street bearings are preserved.
Modern Cable Street mural and other post-1936 features are excluded from the 1936 world.
St George's Town Hall, St George's Methodist mission and St George-in-the-East church are not conflated.
No essential route depends on an unverified historic courtyard, alley or passage.
Approximate barricade/event locations are described as interpretations rather than surveyed 1936 coordinates.
